_comment: Companion to `namespace_import_of_external_via_node_esm_shim` with the shim kept alive by a side effect. Here the chunk's own `named_imports` already report node mode, so a recorded non-node use would disagree with them and flip the chunk into the mixed-mode path, emitting two bindings for one observation. Pins the single correct `__toESM(mod, 1)`.
